unified_dsr_source_operational_extractio.title: Unified DSR Source Operational Extractions
unified_dsr_source_operational_extractio.purpose: Combine translated per-source DSR operational extraction YAML records into readable chunked YAML streams for AI and human review.

chunking_policy.chunk_document_structure: Document 1 is a chunk manifest. Documents 2..N are complete original extraction records copied from source YAML files.

source_files: Design science research in operations management  is there a single type .yaml
J of Ops Management - 2016 - Aken - Conducting and publishing design science research.yaml

ai_reading_instructions: Read this sidecar first to identify chunk files, record ordering, hashes, source IDs, and titles.
Open chunk files in chunk_index order. Each chunk is a YAML multi-document stream.
In each chunk, document 1 is a manifest; documents 2 through N are complete extraction records under dsr_source_operational_extraction_record.
Use source_file, extraction_record_id, and source_id together when citing or cross-referencing records.
Do not infer that source PDFs or copyrighted source texts are included; these chunks contain extraction records only.
